async_completion_review.scope: One seed, new operand range and fixed dataset. Post-hoc subsets are descriptive. This completes only the three-method 30-step study, not the separate long-run matrices.

async_timing_audit.scope: Read-only reanalysis of completed, paired seed-42, 30-update, batch-64 runs. No training run launched or changed.

formulas.training: sum(perf/actor_train_time for exactly one actor record for each rollout_id 0..29)
formulas.step_time: perf/train_time + perf/train_wait_time; a framework-derived quantity, not the top-level elapsed_seconds

actor_train.scope: Wall-clock time of model.train(...) block, including before-step reference hook (and first-call lazy ReferenceState initialization), all 64 forward/backward microbatches, correction/reference diagnostics, optimizer and scheduler update, and training logging. train.scope: Outer timer additionally includes advantage/return computation, rollout-data postprocess and logging.

clock.scope: time.time elapsed, not isolated CUDA-event kernel timing. No explicit device synchronize in timer itself; training metric .item() calls and reference diagnostics perform synchronization during block.

perf_reset.scope: Reports timer values then resets each training update; perf/step_time adds train_wait to train.

end_to_end.scope: Starts before ray.init, includes training/rollout model init, rollout, weight transfers, evaluation, training and diagnostics; final time recorded after train(args) returns and before ray.shutdown. CLI parse and imports precede clock.

loss_hook.scope: diagnostics.jsonl seconds times loss hook only; misses preceding native forward and later backward/optimizer. GRPO original policy_loss_function also occurs after diagnostic timer. Cannot label this train time.

limitations: All values come from one paired seed and 30 updates. This is an instrumented study, not production throughput.
Actor training times include expensive reference/gradient audits and hooks; they do not isolate incremental HVP cost.
Async rollout can overlap actor training. Do not add worker rollout elapsed to actor elapsed to estimate end-to-end runtime.
Neither a pure forward/backward/optimizer breakdown nor diagnostic-free runtime is recorded in these logs.

cpu_probe.definition: Single-prompt CPU logit-margin full-parameter gradient basis construction; optional create_graph + one HVP in independent/qwen_fullgrad_20261011/run.py:95-104. Excludes optimizer, sampling, async scheduler and end-to-end training. Different CPU probe/configuration; cannot interpret 3.05x as native training slowdown.

measurement_contracts.full_vocabulary: Exact one-position forward-distribution moments over all output tokens. Weight second moment is 1+chi2(p||q), not parameter-gradient variance.
measurement_contracts.binary: Variance of the FP32 full-parameter estimator for a separately normalized A/B policy; group size 4 with group-standardized advantages. Six configurations, eight prompts, exact 16-group enumeration. Reported variance ratios divide arithmetic means of absolute variances across prompts, not mean per-prompt ratios.
measurement_contracts.quantization: Explicit group-128 round/dequantize simulation on 497614848 linear-weight parameters, excluding lm_head; all kernels/activations FP32. Native low-bit engines not tested.
measurement_contracts.correction: Same master checkpoint, no lag; parameter-displacement HVP is zero. No q-oracle Jacobian or q-target bias measured.
measurement_contracts.interpretation: Clipping controls large IS weights while changing the estimator mean. Lower gradient variance alone is not evidence of better optimization; group advantages can vanish for concentrated policies.

validation.gradient_scope: Native FP32 trainer full-parameter weighted-loss backward versus binary margin-VJP contraction; prompt 0, balanced four-action group.

config.quantization: Deterministic round-to-nearest symmetric absmax per output-row input-group of 128. qmax=2^(bits-1)-1, codes in [-qmax,qmax]. Linear weights except lm_head; norms, embeddings, convolutions and activations remain FP32. Dequantized weights execute FP32 kernels. NOT a native INT kernel, calibrated GPTQ/AWQ, or speed benchmark.
config.limitations: Full-vocabulary metrics concern forward distributions and importance weights, NOT full-parameter gradient variance. Full-parameter estimator variance is evaluated separately for the constrained A/B policy, without claiming a differentiable low-precision q oracle. Same master checkpoint, no checkpoint-lag HVP.
